description: This file defines the TransactionsService class which provides CRUD operations for transactions in a finance tracking application. It interacts with an API client to perform network requests for listing, creating, updating, and deleting transactions.

classes.name: TransactionsService
classes.description: Provides methods to perform CRUD operations on transactions through an API client.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of transactions with optional filtering parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new transaction with specified details.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing transaction identified by its ID with provided data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a transaction by its ID.
